item.title: Demnikos #5484 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The Gorgonides made room
item.description: Demnikos #5484 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The Gorgonides made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Demnikos is an initiate, and came back remembering.
